title: Bitcoin slips after rebounding from July 14 low that triggered $2 billion of liquidations
content: Bitcoin (BTC) is down 1.6% since midnight UTC at around $64,300, after falling to $62,100 on Sunday, its lowest since July 14, as traders await Nvidia earnings.

title: JPMorgan and DBS let clients move dollars across borders on weekends
content: DBS and JPMorgan have connected their blockchain-based deposit networks, letting approved clients move tokenized U.S. dollars between Singapore and the U.S. at any time, including weekends.

title: Harvard, Dartmouth keep Bitcoin ETF stakes steady as fund gains 42% in Q3

title: German Lawmakers Back Customs Powers to Seize Crypto of 'Unclear Origin'
content: A new law lets Germany's customs agency freeze assets worth more than €100,000 without a criminal case if their origin is in doubt.

title: How Wall Street Is Racing to Claim the Onchain Dollar
content: From Goldman and Citi’s $270 million “Project Faro” to SoFi, Anchorage, Mastercard, Visa and Circle, traditional finance is racing to claim the onchain dollar once dominated by Tether and Circle.

title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $2.1 Billion in November as Outflow Streak Hits Seven Days
content: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $185.4 million on Friday, their seventh straight day of outflows, pushing November losses to about $2.1 billion as Bitcoin fell toward $64,000.
